articles.title: A 4-Goal Party, a Tiny Island's Big Moment, and a World Cup Full of Surprises!
articles.summary: The U.S. men's soccer team crushed Paraguay 4-1 in their first World Cup game. Folarin Balogun scored twice—something no American had done since 1930! Tiny Curaçao (just 158,000 people) scored against Germany before losing 7-1. Scotland shocked everyone by beating Haiti.

articles.title: Trump Turns 80 with a UFC Fight Night at the White House!
articles.summary: President Trump celebrated his 80th birthday by hosting a UFC fighting event on the White House lawn. He also announced a deal to end the war with Iran. Some fighters said wild things, and one even put a chain around the president's neck. The party went past 1 a.m. with fireworks!

articles.title: Spain Stunned! Tiny Cape Verde Holds Soccer Giants to a 0-0 Tie
articles.summary: Spain, one of the best soccer teams in the world, couldn't score against Cape Verde, a country with just 500,000 people playing its first World Cup game ever. Spain's star Lamine Yamal came off the bench but couldn't break through. Cape Verde's goalkeeper made amazing saves to earn a famous draw.
